svg.title: How prideQC computes QC metrics from a spectrum stream
svg.desc: A synthetic 90 minute DDA LC-MS/MS run is reduced to TIC, base-peak, scan-rate, charge, isolation-window and repeated-target metrics. Formulas are those used in prideQC's metric code.

text.font-family: Arial, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, 'Liberation Sans', 'Nimbus Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif

svg.text: From a spectrum stream to compact QC metrics

text.font-family: Arial, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, 'Liberation Sans', 'Nimbus Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif

svg.text: Synthetic 90-minute DDA LC-MS/MS run. Every value shown is computed by prideQC's own metric code on the synthetic scans.
